hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */node_modules/*) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(pnpm -s exec tsx scripts/check-prose.ts "$f" 2>&1) && exit 0; echo "prose check failed (long dash or curly quote): $out" >&2; exit 2
